name: pi-llama-slot-isolation
description: Prevents concurrent pi sessions from clobbering each other's llama.cpp KV cache — each session is pinned to the best available slot (empty > cold > low tokens > low id) via the server's /slots endpoint, coordinated across windows through a state file
